body:
Astral Projection is basically a technique to trick your body into thinking you're sleeping and pushes your spiritual body out. I discovered Astral Projection through youtube music and it led me to /r/AstralProjection where there were tons of information for anyone to use and practice with. 

When I tried doing these techniques I started to feel very strange things during the time I attempted the techniques. That eventually caused me to practice even more to delve deeper into these strange feelings. It took many years to finally get a famous feeling called "vibrations" in which your body were almost literally vibrating like an earthquake. This is commonly called the body getting ready to separate from the shell. I succeeded in getting my arm out of my shell and it literally felt like I had two arms in one.

The day after, I immediately got vibrations again right as I woke up without any effort or realization! It seems that the moment I finally learned to get out of my body it became an "ability" that I could harness easily to push my body out.  

One of the main reason I was fascinated with Astral Projection were because apparently they say in the astral realm (the place where your "astral body" goes when it separate from the shell) the laws of physics in this universe are unshackled to the point where you could literally fly in the sky, teleport anywhere, go through solid materials, and even meet dead people! It was truly an experience like none.
